endorsements.quote: The research team will take externally developed predictive AI models for patient outcomes in cardiovascular disease and cancer and assess their performance, fairness, and bias when using ATHS data.

AI/ML development to address health disparities should adhere to several key principles: (a) be built from equitable datasets that represent marginalized groups, (b) considerations of equity must occur at all stages of algorithm development, (c) development teams need to be more diverse in terms of stakeholders and backgrounds, and (d) ethical standards must be established ( Green et al., 2024 ).

unlisted_practices: Use community-based participatory research methods to co-design AI/ML models with Indigenous communities, embedding Ethical, Legal and Social Implications (ELSI) research throughout the AI lifecycle.
Establish a community advisory board to guide and assist with interpretation of AI/ML model development.
Respect Indigenous data sovereignty and Tribal governance of data used to develop and deploy AI/ML models.
Establish a body within the health system that provides recommendations on AI/ML security, privacy, governance and policy.

screen.reason: Describes a participatory design, development, governance, and monitoring framework for AI/ML in the Alaska Tribal Health System, outlining a project roadmap and recommendations rather than presenting comparative empirical evaluation results.
